gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 identifies that Algorithm 2 compares the angular distance d against 1/sqrt(n) instead of the angular bound arccos(1/sqrt(n)), demonstrates the resulting false classification at n=2, and supplies the precise correction for both thresholds. This is the same scale/threshold defect as the gold issue.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both identify the use of the non-angular quantity 1/sqrt(n) in Algorithm 2's angular threshold tests, causing both counterexample and extremality classification errors.

component_coverage.gold_component: Algorithm 2 centers both angular comparison predicates at 1/sqrt(n) rather than theta_n=arccos(1/sqrt(n)), so exact extremal and nonextremal inputs can be misclassified.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly states the angular target, gives the n=2 counterexample and false rejection, notes the same mismatch in the lower threshold, and specifies replacing 1/sqrt(n) by arccos(1/sqrt(n)) in both tests.
